entries.title: Psalms 3:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm of David when he fled from Absalom his son.>> LORD, how they have increased who trouble me! Many [are] they who rise up against me.

entries.title: Psalms 3:2
segments: Many [are] they who say of me, "[There is] no help for him in God." Selah

entries.title: Psalms 3:3
segments: But You, O LORD, [are] a shield for me, My glory and the One who lifts up my head.

entries.title: Psalms 3:4
segments: ¶I cried to the LORD with my voice, And He heard me from His holy hill. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 3:5
segments: I lay down and slept; I awoke, for the LORD sustained me.

entries.title: Psalms 3:6
segments: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people Who have set [themselves] against me all around.

entries.title: Psalms 3:7
segments: Arise, O LORD; Save me, O my God! For You have struck all my enemies on the cheekbone; You have broken the teeth of the ungodly.

entries.title: Psalms 3:8
segments: Salvation [belongs] to the LORD. Your blessing [is] upon Your people. Selah
